q: In Homotopy Type Theory (HoTT), the identity type a =_A b is interpreted as:
opts: The type of paths (continuous paths in the space A) from a to b
A proposition with at most one proof
The set of bijections from a to b
exp: HoTT: identity types are path types — a proof of a=b is a path from a to b in the space A. Higher identities p=_{a=b}q are homotopies between paths. This gives types the structure of ∞-groupoids, mirroring homotopy theory.
